policy.selection: Minimum mean KL(Jev-1.13.0 || model) on calibration split, including fitted temperatures. Ties choose v1. Calibration is tuning data, not independent evaluation.
policy.test_status: Test was inspected after round1. Round2 results are exploratory, not a blind held-out claim. Historical corpus is known regression data, never model selection.
policy.budget: Two training runs; no selection by test or original corpus

limitation: Calibration labels also fitted temperatures. This is tuning fit, not independent quality; round2 test was already inspected after round1.
